newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Richemont says Nethold gain may be delayed.
newsitem.headline: Richemont says Nethold gain may be delayed.

text.p: Richemont SA said a television deal between France's Canal Plus and Dutch television company Nethold will have a favourable impact on Richemont results, but gains may not be seen before the coming fiscal year.

"We anticipate that the transaction will impact favourably on Richemont's results...As a result of the regulatory process, however, it may only prove possible to complete the transaction during the final quarter of the current financial year, thus limiting its positive impact on the current year's results," Richemont chairman Nikolaus Senn said in remarks prepared for the annual meeting.
Nethold is jointly held by the South African controlled industrial holding firm Richemont and MCL-Multi Choice Ltd.

Last week Canal Plus and Nethold announced plans for a merger which calls for Canal Plus to buy 100 percent of the capital of Nethold from Richemont and MIH Holding Ltd, paying with 6.1 million new Canal Plus shares and $45 million in cash. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
